entry.name: FeelSight
entry.title: Neural feels with neural fields: Visuo-tactile perception for in-hand manipulation
entry.summary: In-hand rotation of 6 objects by a proprioceptive RL policy on an Allegro hand (on a Franka Panda) with four DIGIT fingertips, filmed by three RealSense D435 RGB-D cameras; 30 real-world runs of 30 s, and the 40 simulated runs in the same release are not covered by this entry.
entry.hand: Allegro Hand (16 DoF) on Franka Panda

sensor.note: DIGIT RGB images, 240x320 (width x height) JPEG, one file per frame under allegro/<finger>/image/ for index, middle, ring and thumb; 30 Hz per the paper. Real runs have no tactile depth or contact masks (those exist only in the simulated part).

scale.text: Real: 30 in-hand rotation runs of 30 s (6 objects x 5), 15 min. Simulated (not covered): 40 runs (8 objects x 5) plus an occlusion set

entry.access: Hugging Face suddhu/Feelsight, ungated: feelsight_real.tar.gz (13.6 GB) holds the real runs; feelsight.tar.gz (25.1 GB) and feelsight_occlusion.tar.gz (8.9 GB) are simulation; assets.tar.gz (1.2 GB) holds object meshes. The members of one run are spread through the archive, so one run needs the whole 13.6 GB stream.
caveats: One task (policy-driven in-hand rotation, 20 Hz commands, no teleoperation) and 30 s per run.
Files of all 30 real runs are interleaved in feelsight_real.tar.gz (the first 150 MB already holds members of every run), so extracting one run means reading the whole archive.
Real-world object pose is a pseudo-ground-truth from three-camera tracking with scanned meshes (paper); where it is stored in the release was not confirmed.
data.pkl is a dill pickle and was not opened; the official loader reads time, allegro.base_pose, allegro.joint_state, digit_info and realsense.<camera>.intrinsics/pose from it.
The paper notes that the real DIGIT gel is less sensitive than in simulation, giving sparser contact.
The release also has per-run camera videos (videos/<object>_<run>_<camera>.mp4, H.264), which the dataset card does not list.

sample.rules_applied: 1 task (<= 6), taken. With 3 tasks or fewer: 2-3 episodes per task from different objects, at least 3 in total. Runs are 30 s, inside 10-60 s, so no window. Contact check: DIGIT frames differ from the run's first frame for >= 1 s on at least one finger; swap a run if not.
